fields.name: event_of_default (non-payment)
fields.source_text: Non-Payment. Any Borrower fails to pay (i) when and as required to be paid herein, in the currency required hereunder, any amount of principal of any Loan or any L/C Obligation

fields.name: event_of_default (specific covenant)
fields.source_text: Specific Covenants. Any Borrower fails to perform or observe any term, covenant or agreement contained in any of Section 7.03, 7.05 or 7.11 or Article VIII; or

fields.name: event_of_default (other default)
fields.source_text: Other Defaults. Any Borrower fails to perform or observe any other covenant or agreement (not specified in subsection (a) or (b) above) contained in any Loan Document
